"""DeepSeek-V4-Pro TP8 MoE decode on gfx950: 385 experts (the shared one last), top 7, MXFP4 weights in aiter's
16 x 16 shuffle with gate and up interleaved, e4m3 activations, the clamped SwiGLU at the call's swiglu_limit.

Two launches of precompiled code objects (codeobjects.py) a call: up sorts the tokens by expert and computes the gate
and up projections and the activation; down computes the down projection and the weighted sum into out. A call of n
tokens runs the smallest bucket of at least n tokens."""

import base64
import struct
import zlib

import torch

from aklr.core.jit import hsaco

from .codeobjects import BUCKETS

_PACK = {"ptr": "<Q", "u32": "<I", "f32": "<f"}


def _kernel(stage):
    return hsaco.Kernel(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(stage["code_object"])), stage["symbol"])


_KERNELS = {bucket: {s: _kernel(spec[s]) for s in ("up", "down")} for bucket, spec in BUCKETS.items()}
# the workspace the two launches share, by (device, bucket): zero when allocated, and every call leaves it zero
_WORKSPACES = {}


def _launch(kernel, stage, values, device):
    kernarg = bytearray(stage["kernarg_bytes"])
    for name, (kind, offset) in stage["args"].items():
        value = values[name]
        struct.pack_into(_PACK[kind], kernarg, offset, value.data_ptr() if kind == "ptr" else value)
    kernel.launch((stage["grid"],), (stage["block"],), kernarg, device=device)


def run(
    *,
    hidden_states,
    w1,
    w2,
    topk_weights,
    topk_ids,
    w1_scale,
    w2_scale,
    activation,
    quant_type,
    doweight_stage1,
    gate_mode,
    act_quant,
    expert_mask,
    beta,
    linear_beta,
    swiglu_limit,
    out_dtype,
    out,
):
    n = hidden_states.shape[0]
    bucket = min(b for b in BUCKETS if b >= n)
    spec, kernels = BUCKETS[bucket], _KERNELS[bucket]
    device = hidden_states.device
    workspace = _WORKSPACES.get((device, bucket))
    if workspace is None:
        workspace = {
            name: torch.zeros(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device) for name, size in spec["workspace"].items()
        }
        _WORKSPACES[(device, bucket)] = workspace
    values = {
        "x": hidden_states,
        "topk": topk_ids,
        "topkw": topk_weights,
        "w1": w1,
        "w1s": w1_scale,
        "w2": w2,
        "w2s": w2_scale,
        "y": out,
        "ntok": n,
        "clamp": float("inf") if swiglu_limit is None else float(swiglu_limit),
        "part": torch.empty(spec["up"]["scratch_bytes"], dtype=torch.uint8, device=device),
        **workspace,
    }
    _launch(kernels["up"], spec["up"], values, device)
    _launch(kernels["down"], spec["down"], values, device)
    return out
